svg.text: Sheet 3 · Power domains and on-module sensors
VDD_5V_IN -> FMU 3.3 V rail; four switched sensor LDOs with ADC supervision; IMU3, BARO2, heater driver
CUAV V6X FMUM (RC11, 07-2023) · reverse-engineered from PX4 fmu-v6x board files + Pixhawk DS-010/DS-012 · not vendor data
3.3 V step-down, ~1 A (QFN + 2.2 uH inductor, bottom-centre of MCU side)
always on. Feeds U1, FRAM, SE050, LEDs, SD switch and X1-84/86
VDD_5V_IN arrives on X1-49/51/53/55 (4 pins, 1.5 A budget) and also leaves to the IMU board on J3-28 for the heater.
Input: 2x 10 uF + 100 nF. Output: 22 uF + 100 nF. FMU_VDD_3V3 is exported so the base can power its EEPROM / LEDs / pull-ups.
3.3 V LDO 300 mA w/ EN (SOT-23-5, e.g. TLV75533 / RT9080)
3.3 V LDO 300 mA w/ EN (SOT-23-5, e.g. TLV75533 / RT9080)
domain 2: IMU2 ICM-42688-P (IMU board, SPI2) -> J3-32
3.3 V LDO 300 mA w/ EN (SOT-23-5, e.g. TLV75533 / RT9080)
domain 3: IMU1 BMI088 (IMU board, SPI3) -> J3-6
3.3 V LDO 300 mA w/ EN (SOT-23-5, e.g. TLV75533 / RT9080)
domain 4: I2C4 devices: RM3100, ICP-20100 #1, EEPROM (IMU board) -> J3-16
SCALED_V5 [PB1 / ADC1_INP5]: VDD_5V_IN through 10k / 10k divider (2.5 V nominal). PX4 reports it as the 5 V rail voltage.
6-axis IMU #3, SPI1 mode 3, up to 7 MHz; PX4 rotation ROTATION_ROLL_180_YAW_270 (-R 14)
REGOUT: 100 nF to GND. VDD/VDDIO: 100 nF each. Decoupling right at the pins.
TDK ICP-20100 LGA-10 2.0x2.5 metal lid (in the slotted island)
barometer #2, I2C2 addr 0x63; PX4 driver icp201xx -X (external bus 2)
The routed slot around it is mechanical stress relief: PCB flex would otherwise show up as pressure error.
I2C2 is shared with the base (GPS2 / power monitor 2 connectors) and has 1.5k pull-ups to FMU_VDD_3V3 on the module.
HEATER [PB10, TIM2_CH3 capable] runs straight to J3-30.
The switching MOSFET and the heating resistors sit on the IMU board,
fed from raw VDD_5V_IN on J3-28. PX4 drives it as a slow PWM/on-off
output (GPIO_HEATER_OUTPUT) to hold the IMUs at a set temperature.
